dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density of high-intensity pixel clusters is highest in the anterior-dorsal region, manifesting as solid amorphous patches without internal gradients. Secondary density of smaller, localized high-intensity dots is distributed across the mid-lateral plane.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent central 'O' structures form a near-equilateral triangular geometry. A secondary alignment consists of four smaller ring centroids forming a distorted linear chain extending posteriorly at a downward angle from the central cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, irregular high-contrast white patch lacking internal structure is present on the anterior-dorsal ridge, distinct from the surrounding annular patterns.
